items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...scored regularly for Ida Ray Hutton, Glenn Miller, Jan Savitt, Artie Shaw. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's what it was.

ctx.x: And maybe three or four street cars would jam up and he wouldn't move because he would fight you. The guys wouldn't bother him. And they'd call the cops. At the time the cops were getting ready to come, Ben would run and they couldn't find him. They always had that -- they'd say, what's that? Oh, Ben Webster in the middle of the street car track.
He was always mischievous, was he?
